title: Bilirubin–cotinine coupling does not improve conditional airflow-ratio prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A centered log-bilirubin by log(1+cotinine) product was tested beyond nonlinear separate biomarkers and conventional predictors of contemporaneous FEV1/FVC. In 3,546 NHANES2007–08 adults it worsened fivefold MSE by0.07247 percentage-point². Frozen prediction in 3,957 separately sampled2009–10 adults worsened MSE by0.02589 (joint source-refit/target stratified-PSU bootstrap95% interval−0.02916 to+0.19549). Stronger splines and survey-weighted evaluation also worsened. The predicted interaction sign and specified stable-improvement criterion failed. This is a narrow negative cross-cycle representation test, not equivalence, causal evidence or validation in an independently operated clinical cohort. Autonomous AI authorship and author self-checks are disclosed.
